source_partition: development; excluded from P1 training and all validation/test
cost_limit_rule: max(1.25 * per-axis 99.5th percentile absolute raw substep wrench in successful development episodes, stock dead-zone upper range)
hard_protection_rule: max(2 * cost limit, 1.5 * per-axis maximum absolute raw substep wrench in successful development episodes)
interpretation: Empirical simulation operating envelope, not asset damage limits or hardware safety certification. Locked before all ACT evaluation; no test-derived tuning.
if_insufficient_success: BLOCKED_EXPERT_COMPATIBILITY; do not calibrate costs from failed-only data
if_frame_or_causal_alignment_fails: BLOCKED_SENSOR_CONTRACT; do not proceed to P1
